# OLYMPUS v0.0.4, needs and the first skip: the build sheet

Written 2026-11-06 for the round's four implementers (body, time, stage, hud) and the lead who integrates: the contract between roles building in parallel without talking. Where it is silent the docs decide (DESIGN.md and the user's rules, then TECH §1.3 on implementation, then the sections); my own choices are marked (my call); every disagreement settled here is in §8.

**The release.** ROADMAP §4.1's "0.0.5 needs and the first skip" row, cut as v0.0.4 (CONTRACTS §18). **The user plays**: a shower, a night's sleep, the klaxon at 02:30. **Acceptance moments** (ROADMAP §4.4): **3, "Ten minutes under the shower"**: R at a stall; the zoom, steam, the watch running fast, the outcome strip, back to the world 10 minutes later and clean. Must hold: the full splash lasts 4.3 s (TIME §6.2), every need ran through the gap (the user, 2026-10-28: "when sleeping, the hunger meter is frozen that's a bug"), lived and skipped give the same body (`body-skip`, `time-parity`). **4, "The klaxon at 02:30"**: asleep in the rack, the alert drill stops the night's skip at its exact second: the beat in the vignette, the zoom out into the dark bay, the instinct's line, the late card if you dawdle. Must hold: the landing is exact to the tick (TIME test 9), and the slip lay inside the night.

**The user's rules hold over every section**: places authored, what happens in them procedural (the drill's night and minute are drawn: §8, item 2); every person generated; 16 px/m chibi; every picture and sound made by code; nothing pops in view, no fast travel, graphics over words, AZERTY labels on physical codes, every need runs through every gap.

**Rules of the round**: only your own files (§1), a change elsewhere goes in your issues written out exactly; no commits or releases; never `.play/`, :8200, :8201 or the sibling projects; heavy browser tests on your own `OLYMPUS_TEST_PORT`, servers killed; CPU ceilings × `machine().k`, printed; look at what you draw (`node tools/shot.mjs`, 16 px/m).

**Interfaces first.** Each role first writes the exports of §2, stubbed (signatures, shapes, constants), then fills them; test against your own stub of a dependency until it is real, and say so. **Merge order**: time (it holds game.js, facts.js, the activities), body, stage, hud; `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs` after each.

## 2. Interfaces

Signatures in JavaScript; `state` the saved state, `bus` the core bus, `pid` a person id, times integer game ms, positions metres in the area frame, `ms` arguments default to `state.clock.ms`.

### 2.1 body (BODY §2 to §9, §16.1)

**The record** lives on the person, `state.people[pid].body` (CONTRACTS §9); the domain claims no top-level key. Shape and template defaults in §3. Every function below is pure on its arguments except those marked *writes*.

```js
// src/sim/body/body.js
BODY_V = 2
bodyOf(state, pid) → body | null            // the record, its absent ledgers read from the template (withDefaults); null without a person
startBody(person, ms, lonEDeg) → body       // the template (a marine at reveille after a standard night) advanced along REFERENCE_SOL to ms (§8, item 10)
envAt(state, pid) → { gG: 0.38, pKpa, airC, outdoors, area, room }   // floor 66.0 kPa and ROOM_C 20 °C; ground 65.9 kPa, OUTDOOR_C −10 °C
segOf(state, pid, ms) → { env, load }       // load from time's doing.js activityNow() when an activity runs, else body.held's live mix
  // load = { metG, hiFrac, lieFrac, sleepIntent, wetFrac, outFrac, posture }: the step's means; metG already scaled by g and load (BODY §3.1)
bodyAdvance(body, seg, fromMs, toMs, ctx = {}) → { events: [{ atMs, kind, ... }], crossed: [{ atMs, ledger, from, to }] }   // writes body; exact composition (BODY §2.6)
bodyPeek(body, seg, fromMs, atMs) → body    // an advanced copy; the original untouched (the splash may read it)
nextCrossings(body, seg, fromMs, { untilMs = fromMs + 24 h }) → [{ atMs, ledger, band, interrupt, prio: 3 }]   // atMs rounded UP to a whole second; sorted
bodySync(state, pid, ms, bus) → { events, crossed }   // writes: brings the body from body.atMs to ms under segOf, consumes the live mix, emits body-stage and body-event; THE door every writer goes through first
isAsleep(state, pid, ms) → bool
// changes: each calls bodySync(state, pid, ms, bus) first, then applies, then emits body-event
intake(state, pid, { kcal = 0, waterL = 0, food = 'snack' }, ms, bus)
relieve(state, pid, { bladderK = 0, bowelK = 0 }, ms, bus)   // the fractions emptied (BODY §5: a head 1.0, the bowel 0.9 × fraction done)
wash(state, pid, { waterMin, cold = false }, ms, bus)        // BODY §6's rule; hair wet until ms + WET_HAIR_MS; stress −10 (cold: +3)
groom(state, pid, { teeth = false, shave = false, face = false }, ms, bus)   // shave: stubbleH 0; face: grime × 0.9
sleepBegin(state, pid, ms, { bed: 'own-rack' | 'rack' | 'seat' }, bus)        // lying with intent; latency and depthK fixed here (BODY §7.1)
sleepEnd(state, pid, ms, { by: 'natural' | 'reveille' | 'alert' | 'player' | 'body' }, bus) → { inertia: 0 | -2 | -3, untilMs }
```

**The domain** (`src/sim/body/domain.js`, registered by game.js: §2.2.9):

```js
bodyDomain = { name: 'body', owner: 'BODY', keys: [], idMaps: {}, idFields: {},
  init: () => {},                                  // nothing at init; start() below
  start(state) {},                                 // a new game: the player's body = startBody(person, clock.ms) where the fill left none
  fast: { bodyFast: bodyFastStep },                // the player: this tick's load into body.held (metG × TICK_MS, …), stamina (BODY §8)
  slow: [{ name: 'body', step: bodySlowStep, steady: () => true, nextChangeMs: () => Infinity }],
                                                   // bodySync(player, toMs); then re-solve the next interrupting crossing when the load's signature changed
  events: { body: onBodyEvent, 'body-hazard': onHazard },   // a crossing (prio 3): emits body-interrupt; an accident hazard: the accident
  upgrades: [['body:v2', upgradeBodies]] }
```

The live mix: `bodyFastStep` adds this tick's load (from `activityNow` when one runs, else from the player's gait: idle 1.5, stroll 2.5, walk 3.0 kind walk, run 8.0 kind run; lying 1.0) into `body.held = { ms, metG, hi, lie, out }` (saved: a save mid-minute resumes exactly, BODY §2.5). `bodySync` consumes it. In an outcome skip no fast layer runs and `segOf` reads the activity's constant load; in a fast-forward the per-tick mix carries the same load, so the two agree to float rounding (§8, item 8). **The crossing event**: `post(state, { atMs, prio: 3, kind: 'body', src: 'body:<pid>', who: pid, line, payload: { ledger, band } })`, the earliest interrupting crossing only, cancelled by `src` and posted again when the load's signature (`body.held.sig`, saved) changes. Interrupting crossings (BODY §23.3): bladder 700 mL, bowel 450 g, thirst 6%, hunger weak; asleep, also the bladder at 450 mL and natural waking (BODY §7.1). **Hazards** (BODY §2.6): from bursting (≥ 700 mL, 3% a minute) and desperate (≥ 450 g, 2% a minute), `hazard(state, { src: 'body:<pid>:bladder', key, ratePerMin, kind: 'body-hazard', prio: 3 })`, cancelled by relief.

**Readers** (`cues.js`, `mods.js`, `motion.js`):

```js
stagesOf(body, ms, lonEDeg) → { hunger, thirst, bladder, bowel, hygiene, fatigue, stamina, stubble, stress, morale }
  // each { band, i (0 = fine), tone: 'fine' | 'note' | 'warn' | 'urgent', words: 'Thirsty.' }; bands in §4
cuesOf(body, ms) → { wetK, grimeK, sweatK, tiredK, stubbleK, bladderK, hungerK, thirstK }   // 0..1, for the figure, the doll and the picture
stripOf(body, ms) → [{ need: 'water'|'food'|'bladder'|'bowel'|'sleep'|'grime'|'heat'|'air'|'pain', band, fill: 0..5, tone }]   // VIEWS §7.6's nine; heat, air, pain fill 0 this round
wordsOf(body, ms) → { line: 'Fed two hours ago; thirsty.', needs: [{ need, band, words }] }   // the C sheet's words (VIEWS §8.2: what the character feels, no numbers)
bodyMods(state, pid, key) → [{ why: 'tired', v: -1, src: 'body:fatigue' }]   // SKILLS §5.4; key 'all' | 'mind' | 'body' | 'hands' | 'eyes' | 'social'
needMods(state, pid, key) → [...]                                          // hunger, thirst, bladder, bowel, fatigue, stamina, grime, kept apart by src
capacityOf(state, pid) → { walkK, runOk, sprintOk, awareK, visionK, canStand }   // awareK unread this round (§8, item 21)
gaitSpeeds({ gG, loadKg = 0, massKg = 75, effFitness = 10, stamina = 100 }) → { strollMs, walkMs, runMs, sprintMs, runOk, sprintOk }   // pure, BODY §16.1 and §16.3, rounded to SPEED_STEP_MS
gaitsOf(state, pid) → the same for the person now                                     // move.js calls it each tick
```

**`src/sim/places/move.js`** (body's this round): `WALK_MS`, `RUN_MS`, `STROLL_MS` stay exported as `gaitSpeeds({ gG: 0.38 })`'s values (1.14, 2.69, 0.75 exactly); `speedOf(input, gaits = MARS_GAITS)`; `playerStep` reads `gaitsOf(state, playerId(state))` (Shift runs only while `runOk`) and does nothing but face while time's `feetHeld(state)` (a lived activity, lying or sitting, a transition playing). Bots (`tests/bots/lib.mjs` `pressToward`) keep reading `WALK_MS`.

The log line at the end, TIME §8.8's voice, picked by `hashPick(lines, id, pid, floor(ms / 12000))`.

```js
// src/sim/time/activities.js
LIVE_MAX_MS = 45_000; SPOT_REACH_M = 0.6; FIXTURE_FREE_M = 0.5
activitiesAt(state, x, z) → [{ id, spotId, fixtureId, use, free }]           // spots within SPOT_REACH_M whose use an activity takes
planOf(state, id, { spotId, args = {} }) → { ok, why, durMs, parts: [{ part, fromMs, toMs, ...rec }], endMs, kind: 'live' | 'ff' | 'outcome', late }
  // args: dress { to: 'utilities' | 'pt' }; sleep { until: 'reveille' | ms }; nap { min: 20 | 45 | 90 }; resume { remainingMs }
lateCheck(state, id, spotId, durMs) → null | { block: 'drill', dueMs, walkMs, endMs, fitMs, label: 'the count at your rack, 02:35' }   // TIME §9.5: ends after due − walk
startActivity(state, bus, ctx, { id, spotId, args, late = null, force = null }) → { ok, why }
  // late: null | 'fit' (shortened to end at due − walk; refused under the activity's min) | 'accepted'; force (tests): 'live' | 'ff' | 'outcome'
// src/sim/time/doing.js (reads time.doing and src/data/activities.js only)
activityNow(state, ms) → null | { id, part, met, kind, posture, sleepIntent, wet, inside, fixtureId, spotId, fromMs, toMs, k }   // the body's load, the stage's vignette, the hud
feetHeld(state) → bool                                    // a lived activity, a skip, lying or sitting, a transition playing
finishActivity(state, bus, endMs, { by, fraction }) → outcome   // closes time.doing: effects (whole or partial), landing pose and outfit, log, activity fact
```

**How an activity runs.** `startActivity` checks (TIME §5.3): not held, no skip, no `time.doing`, the player within `SPOT_REACH_M` of `spotId`, the fixture free (no other actor within `FIXTURE_FREE_M`), its own preconditions (own rack, own locker), then `lateCheck` (refused, `why: 'late'`, unless `late` is given). It writes `time.doing` (§3), steps the player onto the spot (a `step` transition), and posts each part's end but the last as `{ kind: 'activity-part', prio: 5, src: 'time:activity', line? }` at the first whole second at or after it (post() floors, so the rule posts the ceiling): outcome steps end on it, and `activityNow` reads the same boundaries lived or skipped; the last part ends at `toMs`. Under `LIVE_MAX_MS` it is **lived** (`mode 'live'`, feet held, a move key cancels it at its fraction); else `ctx.sim.beginSkip(state, { activity: id, planMs, kind, spotId, posture, mask, chunkMs })`, kind `ff` under `FF_MAX_MS` while `liveActors × planS ≤ FF_ACTOR_S_MAX` (TIME §5.2), else `outcome`; `finishSkip` calls `finishActivity`. A cut `resumable` activity leaves `time.resume = { activity, spotId, remainingMs, untilMs }` ("finish your shower · 7 min", TIME §7.5) for `RESUME_MS` or until the player is 2 m away.

**2.2.2 The skip side** (`skip.js`, TIME §5.3 to §5.9; both engines as v0.0.2 built them): `beginSkip` keeps `spotId` on the record; `skip-start` carries `spotId, vignette, stoppable, chunkMs`; `stops(mask, ev, state)` everywhere (the due layer's fast-forward check too); a stop emits `skip-interrupt { id, atMs, by, prio, letter, kind, line, reflex }`; an `O*`-held event is dispatched, its line to the ticker, its id to `s.held`; `s.result.before = { strip, stages }` at the start. `finishSkip` (TIME §5.8): `finishActivity`, `bodySync(player, end)` (people were placed at each step, unseen only, as built), `skip-end` with `outcome = { body: { before, after }, look: { outfit, wet }, chunk: { offerMs } | null, lines, failedRoll: false }`, the landing (TIME §7.5: the activity's posture and outfit; the cause set by its event), `autosave`. `skipNow` allows a forced `ff` of up to 12 h (`FF_GUARD_TICKS`) for the parity tests.

**2.2.3 Interrupts** (`src/sim/time/interrupts.js`, TIME §7):

```js
PRIO = { D: 0, A: 1, O: 2, B: 3, S: 4 }               // 5: ambient, ticker only
CLASS_MASKS = { hygiene: 'D A O* B−x S(k)', toilet: 'D A O* S(k)', eating: 'D A O B S', sleep: 'D A O B S(w)', rest: 'D A O B S',
                kit: 'D A O B S', block: 'D A O B', watch: 'D A O B P', ride: 'D A O B', day: 'D A O B S' }
parseMask(mask) → { D, A, O: true | 'hold', B: true | { except }, S: true | 'k' | 'w', P }   // '−' or '-' both read
stops(mask, ev, state) → bool   // job events never; prio 5 never; D, A always; O unless O*; B unless B−x and ev.payload.ledger === x;
                                // S by S(k) only payload.social 'knock', S(w) only 'wake'; S over S_PER_SKIP or S_PER_SOL never (TIME §7.4); muted kinds never
letterOf(ev) → 'D' | 'A' | 'O' | 'B' | 'S' | null
```

`time.interrupts = { perSol, perSkip, sol }` counts S stops (reset at a new skip and a new sol); `time.prefs.mute = []` holds S kinds muted (none can be muted this round: the wrist terminal sets them later). Sources this round: **A** the drill; **O** reveille; **B** the body's crossings; no D and no S source exists (tests post synthetic ones).

**2.2.4 The night: reveille, taps, the drill** (`src/sim/time/pod.js`, `src/data/pod.js`):

```js
// src/data/pod.js: TIMES re-exported from src/data/places/sky.js (one record: the lamps and the calls agree)
REVEILLE_H 5.5, REVEILLE_HOLIDAY_H 7.0, TAPS_H 22.0
ALERT_DRILL = { perWeek: 1, fromH: 0.5, toH: 4.5, dueMs: 600_000, endMs: 1_800_000, klaxonMs: 45_000,
                horn: { area: 'melas.echo.1', x: 57.7, z: 8.8 } }
LATE_CLASSES = [[0, 'on-time'], [120_000, 'late-minor'], [600_000, 'late'], [1_800_000, 'very-late']]   // beyond, or never: 'missed'
// src/sim/time/pod.js
nightOf(state, ms) → { sol, tapsMs, reveilleMs, holiday }          // the night beginning on the local sol of ms (or the one in progress)
drillOfWeek(seed, week, lonEDeg) → { drill: solIndex, atMs }        // r = stream(seed, 'time:alert-drill', week): night n = int(r, 7) (Monday night 0), minute = int(r, 241) after 00:30
postNight(state, fromMs)    // cancel src 'time:night', post taps (prio 5, 'Taps. Lights out.'), reveille (prio 2, kind 'reveille'), the drill (prio 1, kind 'alert') if tonight's and after fromMs
lateClass(lateMs) → 'on-time' | 'late-minor' | 'late' | 'very-late' | 'missed'
```

Weeks are absolute (`week = floor((sol − weekdayOf(sol)) / 7)`, SETTING's week, Monday first); a clock time lands on its first whole second at or after it (jobs.js's rule), so the watch reads it: tonight's 02:30 is 02:30:00.091. The time domain's job `solDirector` (`local@20:00`, CONTRACTS §5) calls `postNight`; its `start(state)` (a new game) and its upgrade call it too, so a game started at 23:00 has its reveille. `time.drills.forced` (a test scene, `debug:drill:<ms>`) replaces tonight's draw. `postNight` does nothing without a roster (`hasRoster`): the sandbox keeps v0.0.3's quiet queue, so the determinism suite's skips are not stopped by a drill.

**Event handlers** (the time domain's `events`): `reveille` → log and ticker "Reveille. Lights.", `reveille { atMs, area, holiday }`, `squadCall(state, 'reveille', atMs)`. `alert` → `time.drills.open = { drill, atMs, dueMs, endMs, counted: false }`, posts `alert-count` at due and `alert-end` at end (prio 5, src `time:alert`), emits `alert { phase: 'sound' }`, `squadCall(state, 'alert', atMs)`. `alert-count` → the squad leader's count in the log ("Sgt Okafor counts the bay: 12 of 13 at their racks."), `alert { phase: 'count' }`. `alert-end` → `alert { phase: 'stand-down' }`, `squadCall(state, 'stand-down', atMs)`, a `late { class: 'missed' }` if the player never mustered, `time.drills.open` → `last`. **Muster** (TIME §9.5, §8 item 4): `mustered(state, pid, ms)` is the player standing within 0.6 m of their rack's foot spot, in utilities, no activity running; checked on whole seconds while a drill is open; the first time it holds, `{ block: 'drill', who, dueMs, arrivedMs, lateMs, class }` goes into `time.attend` (the last 50), the `late` fact and the log.

```js
// src/sim/time/alerts.js (Pure.; in SIM_FOR_VIEW, the stage's beacon)
alertNow(state, ms) → null | { drill, kind: 'drill', atMs, dueMs, endMs, phase: 'klaxon' | 'muster' | 'counted', hornOn: bool, horn: { area, x, z } }
musterOf(state, pid) → { spotId, x, z, outfit: 'utilities' }
mustered(state, pid, ms) → bool
```

The klaxon: on from `atMs` for `klaxonMs`, `hornOn` alternating every `KLAXON_CYCLE_MS` 1,500 ms (the audio's whoop, the stage's beacon in hall-2). The bay stays dark (CAREER: "dressing in night lighting").

**2.2.5 The splash's timing** (`src/sim/time/splash.js`, pure; the hud drives it, the stage draws to it; TIME §6.2):

```js
lapseS(gapMin, { short = false }) → s           // clamp(1.4 + 0.95 ln(1 + m/4), 1.6, 8.0); short: SHORT_LAPSE_S
splashPlan(skipStart, opts) → { id, form: 'brief' | 'full', engine, gapMin, inS, lapseS, holdS, outS, totalS }
  // full: gap ≥ FULL_FROM_MS; inS 0.4, holdS 0.8, outS 0.5; brief: inS 0, holdS 0.4, outS 0; an ff's lapse is the engine's own pace (§8, item 13)
ease(τ) → p                                       // piecewise linear: rate 0.4 R over [0, 0.15], R over [0.15, 0.8], 0.4 R over [0.8, 1]; R = 1 / 0.79
targetAt(plan, fromMs, toMs, tLapseS) → ms        // fromMs + ease(t / lapseS) × gap, floored to the minute; toMs once t ≥ lapseS
interruptTimes(prio) → { decelS: 0.35, beatS: 0.6, outS: prio === 0 ? 0.25 : 0.5 }
```

**2.2.6 R, what's at hand** (`src/sim/places/hand.js`): priority **lying or sitting** (rise) > **an activity spot** (within `SPOT_REACH_M`, free) > **a door** (as built) > **the resume** > **the wait** (asked twice, as built).

```js
handOffer(state) → null | { act: 'hand', verb: 'rise' | 'activity' | 'open' | 'close' | 'resume' | 'wait', target, id, spotId,
                            label: 'shower · 10 min, done 19:41', durMs, endMs, late: lateCheck | null,
                            more: [{ id, args, label, durMs }] }      // R held: the choices card (the rack's sleep and naps, the sink's three)
handAction(state, action, bus, ctx)   // { act: 'hand', args: { want: 'rise' | 'activity' | 'door' | 'resume' | 'wait', id?, args?, late? } }; does nothing if the offer changed kind
```

Defaults: a shower stall `shower`; a sink `morning` from 05:00 to 10:00 Melas, else `basin` (more: `basin`, `morning`, `drink`); a urinal `urinate`; a toilet stall `bowel` when the bowel is at could-go or more, else `urinate`; your rack's foot `dress` to utilities while a drill is open and you are not in them, else `sleep` until reveille from 20:00 to 05:30, else `nap` 45 min (more: sleep until reveille, until +1, +2, +4, +8 h, nap 20, 45, 90, `dress`); your locker `dress` to utilities from PT kit or a towel, else to PT (more: the other); a vending machine `snack` or `drink` by its make. Labels: `${offer} · ${durText}, done ${HH:MM}` (TIME §8.1, the watch's helper), with `, the count 02:40` while a drill is open. The new action prefix **`activity`** (time's): `{ act: 'activity', args: { id, spotId, args, late } }` (the late card's answers, the choices card, tests).

**2.2.7 The squad's poses** (`src/sim/people/place.js`, `figure.js`; PEOPLE §4.6, TIME §5.9). A **transition** is a lived change shown in sight, never a pop: the actor's fields hold the end state; `trans` and `dress` hold where it came from and when.

```js
RISE_MS 2_500 (upper berth 3_400: the climb), DOWN_MS 2_500, SIT_MS 1_200, STEP_IN_MS 400, CALL_DELAY_MS [2_000, 20_000]
actor.trans = { kind: 'rise' | 'down' | 'sit' | 'stand' | 'step', fromMs, ms, from: { posture, x, z, y, face, head } }
actor.dress = { fromMs, ms, from: 'pt' | 'utilities' | 'towel', to }
whereIs(state, pid, ms) → as built, plus the calls: from reveille + delay, standing at the rack's foot (PT kit) until 05:40, then the day pose;
                          during a drill: rise at atMs + delay, dress PT → utilities, stand at the rack's foot; at the stand-down + delay,
                          undress to PT, lie down; the fire watch stands at the post and sits again
squadCall(state, cause: 'reveille' | 'alert' | 'stand-down', atMs)   // sets trans and dress on every placed live actor whose room the call reaches, in sight or not
callDelay(pid, cause) → ms                                            // 2,000 + hashInt(18,001, 'call', pid, cause) ms (cosmetic; moves no dice)
poseAt(actor, ms) → { posture, frame, k, x, z, y, face, head, outfit }   // pure: frame 'lie' | 'sitUp' | 'sit' | 'climb' | 'standUp' | 'stand' | 'dress' | 'lieDown'
figureOf(state, actor, ms) → { look, posture, frame, k, x, z, y, face, head, curtain, gait, strideM, outfit,
                               inside: fixtureId | null, activity: { id, part, k } | null, cues }   // cues: the body's cuesOf (zeros for an NPC this round)
```

The rise's keyframes: `lie` 0, `sitUp` 0.35, `sit` 0.55 (on the rack's edge, `SIT_ACROSS_M`), `climb` 0.55 to 0.8 (upper berth only: y from 1.35 to 0), `standUp` 0.8, `stand` 1 (at the foot spot); `down` the reverse. The actors layer applies a `whereIs` change in sight only when it is a transition from the actor's present pose; every other change stays unseen-only (as built). Expired `trans`/`dress` are removed on the actor's bucket second. The player: lying or sitting holds the feet; a move key, R ("get up") or T starts the player's own `rise`. `perception.js`: the player's `asleep` is `isAsleep(state, pid)` (a lying player awake sees from the berth), everyone else's as built.

**2.2.8 The instinct** (`src/sim/skills/instinct.js`, `instinct/base.js`; SKILLS §14, tradecraft's `settle()` ported):

```js
RANK = { calm: 0, note: 1, warn: 2, urgent: 3 }; LINE_MIN_MS 3_000; REPEAT_MS 60_000; HUMOUR_GAP_MS 300_000
settle(prev, fired, ms) → { line, chip, keys, queued }    // tradecraft's rule plus the minimum, the repeat and the chip (SKILLS §14.3)
instinctStep(state, input, bus, ctx)                      // fast layer 'offers': on whole seconds, and on the first tick after a skip or a load
instinctNow(state) → state.$instinct                      // { line: { id, voice: 'di', tone, text, act, ms } | null, chip, keys: [], queued, gone, humourAt } (SKILLS §15.4, runtime)
instinctAction(state, action, bus, ctx)                   // { act: 'instinct', args: { id, act, chip } }: does act if rule id still fires with that act
BASE_RULES = [{ id, voice: 'di', tone, when(state, me, ms) → ctx | null, text: { 1: [≥ 4 lines] }, act(ctx) → string | null, reach: null }]
```

Silent in a splash; only urgent lines while time stands still. **Acts**: `'rise'`, `'dress:utilities'`, `'activity:<id>'` (the fixture you stand at), or null (the line says where: §8, item 12). **Rules** (tier 1; ≥ 4 phrasings each by `hashPick(lines, id, floor(ms / 12000))`): `alarm` (urgent: a drill open, you not mustered; T rises, then dresses you at your rack; "Klaxon. Up, utilities, the foot of your rack. Ten minutes."); warn at the band: `need-bladder` (need; could-go at your rack after 21:00), `need-bowel` (need), `need-thirst` (thirsty), `need-hunger` (hungry: "The mail room's machine has bars."), `need-sleep` (tired after 21:00, exhausted any time), `need-dirt` (unwashed), each T the fixture's activity where you stand; note: `woke` (lying after a call; T rises), `rack` (21:50 to 22:00, away from your rack), `stubble` (over 20 h); calm: `situation` ("Taps at 22:00."). The people domain routes `instinct` here (it held the prefix) and adds `offers: instinctStep`.

**2.2.9 game.js and the scenes.** The changes, exactly: `DOMAIN_ORDER` becomes `['tech', 'time', 'places', 'body', 'people', 'weapons', 'combat', 'world', 'career']` (TIME §5.4's slow order: the place, the body, the people); `BUILT_IN` adds `body: bodyDomain`; `normalise` keeps `start`; `newGame` runs each domain's `start?.(s)` after `postJobs`; `stops` is `interrupts.js`'s, given the state, in `createSkips` and the due layer; `SCENARIOS` and `SCENARIO_SITES` add `'test-shower'` and `'test-night'` (`src/sim/scenarios/tests.js`, site `melas`); the tech domain's debug action adds `debug:drill:<ms>` (marks `meta.debugUsed`, a `[debug]` log line, sets `time.drills.forced` and calls `postNight`). The time domain gains `actions: { activity }`, `events: { reveille, alert, 'alert-count', 'alert-end', taps, 'activity-part' }`, `jobs: { solDirector }`, `fast: { input: activityInput, second: secondStep }` (the autosave count as built, then the muster check), `start`, `upgrades: [['time:pod', upgradePod]]`.

**The scenes** (`src/data/scenes.js`, time's; the hud reads every field):

```js
SCENES = {
  'test-shower': { id: 'test-shower', title: 'Ten minutes under the shower', scenario: 'test-shower', hour: 19.5,
    goal: 'Filthy after PT. The showers are across the hall, in Head A: R at a free stall.',
    aspects: [['splash', 'the zoom, the fast watch, the strip'], ['vignette', 'the stall, the water, the steam'], ['pace', 'ten minutes in four seconds']],
    body: { grime: 58, sweatL: 0.4, stubbleH: 14 }, outfit: 'utilities',
    endOn: { fact: 'activity', phase: 'end', activity: ['shower', 'dress'] } },
  'test-night': { id: 'test-night', title: 'The klaxon at 02:30', scenario: 'test-night', hour: 21 + 55 / 60,
    goal: 'Taps at 22:00. Sleep until reveille. If the klaxon goes: up, in utilities, at the foot of your rack in ten minutes.',
    aspects: [['night', 'the rack and the night going by'], ['klaxon', 'the klaxon and the landing'], ['drill', 'the scramble, the late card, the count']],
    body: { pressureH: 16.4, bladderMl: 250 }, outfit: 'pt', drill: { hour: 2.5 },
    endOn: { fact: 'alert', phase: 'stand-down' } } }
```

Both fills (`tests.js`) are `barracks()` on Monday Sol 590 at their hour, the player at their rack's foot facing up, the outfit, `startBody` then the scene's ledgers; `test-night` sets `time.drills.forced` to that night's 02:30 and posts it. Scenes save nothing (§8, item 24).

### 2.3 stage (VIEWS §4, §5, §7.3; TIME §6)

**What the view reads.** `view.frame(alpha, state, info)` gains `info.splash` (§2.4's frame, or null) and reads, besides what it reads now: `figureOf(state, actor, ms)` for every figure, `ms = clock.ms + alpha × TICK_MS` (the transitions' frames and positions, `outfit`, `inside`, `cues`), `alertNow(state, ms)` (the red beacon in hall-2 while `hornOn`), and the light at `info.splash ? info.splash.shownMs : ms` (the time-lapse shows the light of the time shown).

**What it draws.** (a) The splash (`src/render/splash.js`): full form, the camera eased from zoom 1 to `SPLASH_ZOOM` 3 about `splash.centre` over `in`, everything further than `irisM` from it to ink through the fog's dim with a 1.5 m Bayer edge (`inkK`), nothing drawn beyond; the reverse over `out`; brief form, no zoom, the stage dimmed beyond `BRIEF_RING_M` 6 m with a 1 m Bayer edge. (b) Vignettes (`src/render/vignettes.js`, `src/art/kit/vignette.js`, VIEWS §5.2), by `vignette`, `vk` and `part`: `shower` (the curtain drawn, steam by `part`, water streaks and the timer light while `water`, boots under the curtain; the towel and dressing in `dress`), `sink` (mirror, foam, toothbrush, the razor if shaving), `head` (your back at the urinal), `stall` (the OCCUPIED slide, boots under the door), `rack` (the blanket breathing, the curtain where drawn, the red night light; dressing at the foot in `turn-in`), `locker` (open, the dressing frames), `standby` (the light changing); cosmetics by `hash(activity, solIndex)`. **The beat** (`phase 'beat'`): by `splash.interrupt.kind`: `alert` the red beacon's pulse through the curtain and the steam; `reveille` the overheads coming on; `body` a pulse of the iris edge. (c) Figures (`poses.js`, `outfits.js`): `stroll`, `look`, `glance`, `stairs` (up, down), `sitUp`, `standUp`, `climb`, `lieDown`, `dress` (two frames), `basin` (leaning at a sink), the `towel` outfit (a towel at the waist, at the chest for women), PT kit kept; the wet head (`cues.wetK > 0`: darker hair, a highlight) and the tired walk (`cues.tiredK ≥ 0.5`: head down 1 px, shorter arm swing); `inside` hides the figure behind its fixture. The squad's transitions drawn from `poseAt` frame by frame: never a pop. (d) The doll (`doll({ look, sex, marks, body: cues, outfit })`): wet hair, grime on hands, face and cloth by `grimeK`, sweat patches by `sweatK`, stubble by `stubbleK`, heavy eyelids and dropped shoulders at `tiredK ≥ 0.5`, knees in and a hand at the belt at `bladderK ≥ 0.6`, a hand on the stomach at `hungerK ≥ 0.6`, the towel and PT kit. (e) `squadbay-night` keeps 60 fps; the bench's new scene `splash-sleep` (`{ play: 'barracks', seed: 48213, hour: 21.95, at: { area: 'melas.echo.1', x: 52.075, z: 3.3, face: 'up' }, keys: [['KeyR', 100], [null, 9000]], warmS: 2 }`: R at your rack, the night's full splash) gives `result.splash = { frames, medianMs, p95Ms, over25 }`.

### 2.4 hud (TIME §6, VIEWS §5.4 to §5.6, §7, §8.2, §10, §11; ROADMAP §2.2)

**The splash controller** (`src/ui/hud/splash.js`). On `skip-start` (a bus listener, at once, so the loop's first outcome frame never runs the whole skip) it makes `splashPlan(...)` and calls `loop.skipTarget(fromMs)`; each frame it sets `loop.skipTarget(targetAt(...))` and builds the **splash frame** that `main.js` gives the view as `info.splash`:

```js
{ id, activity, vignette, form: 'brief' | 'full', engine, phase: 'in' | 'lapse' | 'decel' | 'beat' | 'strip' | 'out', k,   // k: 0..1 in the phase
  zoom, irisM, inkK, centre: { x, z },          // centre: the middle of the player and the spot; irisM SPLASH_IRIS_M 3.5 (full), Infinity (brief: ringM 6)
  fixtureId, spotId, fromMs, toMs, shownMs,      // shownMs: fromMs + ease × gap, never past state.clock.ms (the clock waits for the sim)
  vk, part,                                      // (shownMs − fromMs) / gap; the activity's part at shownMs
  interrupt: null | { atMs, prio, letter, kind, line }, ticker: { text, tone } | null, outcome: null | skip-end.outcome }
```

From `skip-end` to the end of `out` the loop holds the pause reason `'splash'` (no game time passes under the beat and the strip; PAUSED never shows for it). **Controls** (TIME §6.4, VIEWS §5.3): Space, Enter, a click: to the end (target `toMs`, the plaque snaps over `WHIRR_S` 0.25); Backspace: `skip:stop` where `stoppable`; Esc: the menu, pausing; T while the strip offers "carry on (15 min)" for `CHUNK_OFFER_S` 1.2: `skip:chunk`. During the strip any key unbound there closes it (never T, Backspace; Esc opens the menu). **Rectangles** (VIEWS §7.5): `CLOCK` (the wrist face at `shownMs`, the slip as `24:00 +12`); the ticker in `INSTINCT` (a line per `TICKER_GAP_S`, the rest to the log) with the splash's keycaps; the outcome strip in `RADIO` (VIEWS §5.6: each need that moved, before, a 1 px arrow, after; the look glyph; "carry on (15 min) · T"); on an interrupt a plaque by kind ("ALARM", "REVEILLE", the body's band word); the rest hidden.

**The instinct line** (`hud/instinct.js`): `instinctNow(state).line` in `INSTINCT`, its tone as the border (urgent red, blinking 3 times), keycaps in AZERTY by code (`T`, `T held` for the chip), then the chip's short line, then R's offer as its own chip (`handOffer(state)`), none on an urgent line but the chip. R and T act on key-up under `TAP_MS` 220, or at 220 ms while held (`src/core/input.js`). T tapped sends `{ act: 'instinct', args: { id, act } }` of the line shown when the key went down; T held, the chip's. R tapped sends the offer's `want`; R held at an offer with `more` opens **the choices card** (`cards/choose.js`, digits); an offer with `late` opens **the late card** (`cards/late.js`: "fit it in · 6 min", "do it anyway", "not now"; TIME §9.5) and sends `{ act: 'activity', args: { …, late: 'fit' | 'accepted' } }` or nothing. R's wait still asks twice (as built).

**The body strip and C** (`hud/strip.js`, `cards/sheet.js`): the strip folded into `WATCH` shows only the glyphs whose band has left fine (VIEWS §7.6); C opens PERSONNEL (VIEWS §8.2, paused): the doll (the stage's `doll()`, `body: cuesOf`), ON YOU (the strip at twice its size, `wordsOf` in words with each need's stage, the on-hover words), THE FILE (name, rank, unit, billet from the roster). **Tests menu, end card, score card** (`cards/tests.js`, `end.js`, `score.js`; ROADMAP §2.2): the title lists `SCENES`; a scene starts `newGame({ scenario, seed, hour })`, shows its goal line for `GOAL_S` 8 s in `TOASTS`, ends on its `endOn` fact once the strip is done (end card: Again with the same seed, Again with a new one, Score); the score card has the three aspects 0 to 100 in steps of 5, a ★, a note, and **Copy my scores** giving one line, `OLYMPUS v0.0.4 · test-shower · seed 48213 · splash 85 · vignette 70 · pace 60 · ★ no · note: …`, kept as `localStorage['olympus.scores'] = { v: 1, scores: [{ scene, version, seed, aspects, star, note, atIso }] }`.

**Sound** (`audio/world.js`, `src/data/sounds.js`; VIEWS §11; all synthesised): the shower's water (noise while `activityNow` is its `water` part), the tap (basin, morning, drink), the flush (`body-event` `void` or `bowel` at a head), the klaxon (`alertNow().hornOn`: a 1.5 s whoop, 600 to 1,100 Hz, at the horn, by `airDb(66)`, then `WALL_DB` and the low-pass halved per wall between the horn's room and yours by `roomOf`: 0 in the same room, 1 next door, 2 beyond), reveille's bugle (`reveille`, the bay's speaker), the splash (the world low-passed to `SPLASH_LP_HZ` and ducked `SPLASH_DUCK_DB` from `in` to `out`, a tick per shown minute, at most `TICK_MAX_HZ`). **`main.js` and the handle**: `?play=test-shower`, `?play=test-night` (with `&hour` to override, `&seed`), `?play=barracks&hour=<h>` as built; the keys card adds T (what the instinct says; held: the next), C (character sheet), R (what's at hand: a door, an appliance, else wait; held: the choices), and in a splash Space, Backspace. `debug.js`'s handle adds `body()` (the record and `stagesOf`), `activity(id, spotId, args)`, `instinct()`, `splash()`, `drill(ms)` (queues `debug:drill:<ms>`), `scores()`.

### 2.5 Facts (`src/core/facts.js`, the time role writes every line; CONTRACTS §11)

| Fact | Payload | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| `activity` (new) | `{ phase: 'start' \| 'end', activity, who, spotId, fromMs, toMs, mode: 'live' \| 'ff' \| 'outcome', fraction, by, outcome }` | TIME |
| `alert` (new) | `{ drill, kind: 'drill', phase: 'sound' \| 'count' \| 'stand-down', atMs, dueMs, endMs, horn: { area, x, z } }` | TIME |
| `reveille` (new) | `{ atMs, area, holiday }` | TIME |

| `skip-end` (as built) | `outcome` as §2.2.2 | TIME |

`body-dead` stays registered and unemitted (no death this round).

- **upgradeState for a v0.0.3 save** (additive; `SAVE_SCHEMA` stays 1): `body:v2` sets every body's `v` to 2 and writes the player's ledgers as `startBody(person, clock.ms, lon)` (flag `mig:body-v2`); `time:pod` fills `time.pod`, `drills`, `attend`, `prefs` and calls `postNight(state, clock.ms)` (flag `mig:time-pod`). A v0.0.3 save mid-wait finishes its wait with mask `D` as saved. A new save is unchanged by both.

## 5. Tests

Names are sentences in the files; here the suite, what it **prints** and what it **holds**. Numbers six spaces in; assertions carry their evidence; CPU ceilings × `machine().k`, printed.

### 5.1 body

- **`body-energy`** (quick). **Prints** basal kcal/24 h (man 1,763, woman 1,392); `REFERENCE_SOL`'s kcal at 0.38, 1.0, 0.134 G; the hunger stages' clock times through it with and without its meals; tradecraft's ladder beside (`HUNGRY_H` 6, `STARVING_H` 14, `WEAK_H` 48, `FAINT_H` 72, `DIE_H` 504). **Holds** 2,770 kcal ±3% at 0.38 G (BODY §3.2); never past peckish with the meals; a night's sleep moving gut and reserve.
- **`body-water`** (quick). **Prints** the sol's ledger (drunk, food and metabolic water, insensible, urine, voids, end balance), thirst's stage times without drinking. **Holds** level ±0.3 L with 2.0 L drunk, 4 to 6 voids (BODY §4.2).
- **`body-elimination`** (quick). **Prints** the bladder's peaks and voids over the sol, a 1 L drink to need and urgent, the bowel's urges after breakfast, the night's bladder at 22:00 and 05:30. **Holds** no wake on the reference night from 250 mL at taps; the accident at 850 mL; the bursting hazard at the same second lived and skipped.
- **`body-hygiene`** (quick). **Prints** grime over the sol, after 1 to 5 water minutes, sols to rank. **Holds** 30, 8, 2, 1, 0 exactly; wet hair 20 min.
- **`body-sleep`** (quick). **Prints** the template; pressure at taps and reveille over three weeks of TIME §9.2 for needs 7.5, 8.0, 8.5 h; when tired begins; the body clock's offset across the slip; tradecraft's fatigue ladder beside (`TIRED_H` 16, `EXHAUSTED_H` 20, `WEAR_H` 3, `WORN_MAX` 12). **Holds** for 8.0 h reveille 0.4 to 1.0 h by Wednesday, never tired in training; φ continuous through the slip (no step over 0.02 h a minute).
- **`body-skip`** (quick; the whole sol heavy). A shower, a night, a 15-minute wait and the whole reference sol, advanced **tick by tick** (50 ms, that tick's load) against **skipped** (a call a segment) and against a split at 1,000 random seconds. **Prints** both bodies and the differences. **Holds** composition to 1e−9 relative; lived against skipped within energy and water 1% (5 kcal, 0.01 L), bladder 5 mL, bowel 1 g, grime 0.5, pressure 0.05 h, stamina 0.5 (BODY §25, TIME §5.5); `nextCrossings` equal to stepping, to the second.
- **`body-gait`** (quick). **Prints** BODY §16.1's six rows from `gaitSpeeds`, a load's bands on Mars, stamina over 60 s of running at Fitness 0, 10, 20. **Holds** Mars 0.75, 1.14, 2.69 exactly, equal to `STROLL_MS`, `WALK_MS`, `RUN_MS`.
- **`body-mods`**, **`body-thermal`** (quick). Every band's mods on each key (tradecraft's stress numbers beside), each on its keys only; tradecraft's `STAGES`, τ, `CORE` beside the port's, the core over 8 h indoors and 1 h out at −10 °C, nothing moving indoors.

### 5.2 time

- **`time-activities`** (quick; test 7, hand offers). **Prints** each duration (shower 10:00, dress 5:12 and 4:24, basin 3:00 and 7:00, morning, sleep 21:55 to reveille 8 h 14 m 35 s, naps), engine and form; `handOffer` at each fixture of Head A and bay-2-1, the mail room's machine, a door, mid-aisle, lying in your rack. **Holds** each verb and label; another berth's rack and locker offer nothing; R twice waits; a door acts at once; an offer changed by its tick does nothing; a drink lived 30 s, cut by a move key at its fraction.
- **`time-interrupts`** (quick; tests 9, 10, §7.4, §7.6). **Prints** the masks table by class and letter against §7.3. **Holds** test 9: an A event in a sleep lands at its exact tick (`clock.ms === atMs`), the sleep accrued to it, prio-5 lines in the ticker; D before S at one second; `e999` before `e1000`; `O*` holds reveille in a shower; `B−hygiene` passes grime and stops on the bladder; S(k) only knocks; one S a skip, three a sol; 7 sols without water land at dehydrated, never past it.
- **`time-pod`** (quick; test 13 as it applies). **Prints** a week from Monday Sol 590 (taps, reveille 05:30 and 07:00 at the weekend, the drill); the draw over 1,000 seeds by weekday and half-hour; the classes at −1, +1, +5, +15, +25 min and never. **Holds** every drill inside 00:30 to 04:30; one seed one draw; `start()` posting tonight at 12:39 and at 23:00; nothing posted in the sandbox.
- **`time-splash`** (quick; test 11). **Prints** `lapseS` at TIME §6.2's gaps, §4's splash seconds, the ease at 0, 0.15, 0.5, 0.8, 1. **Holds** the shower 4.29 s and the night 7.67 s ±0.01; `targetAt` on minutes, `toMs` at the end; no key-wait on the strip without a failed roll.
- **`time-placement`** (quick; test 12). 23:00 skipped to 05:25 asleep; the klaxon lived 30 min facing the squad. **Prints** poses against `whereIs`; each squadmate's delay, rise, dress and count times. **Holds** every pose `whereIs`'s; every change in sight a transition from the pose before, none instant; all at their racks in utilities by the count, lying 5 min after the stand-down.
- **`time-parity`** (heavy; test 8). A shower, a night and a 15-minute wait, `force: 'ff'` against `force: 'outcome'` from one state. **Prints** both bodies, the events' seconds, compute ms. **Holds** §5.1's tolerances; every scheduled event at the same second.
- **`time-determinism`** (quick; test 16): 3,000 ticks, a 2-hour sleep, 3,000 ticks, twice and saved and loaded mid-skip: one digest; µs per tick and per skipped minute printed. **`time-stillness`** (quick; test 17 as it applies): with G held, no offer, no activity, only urgent lines, no skip.
- **`instinct`** (quick; SKILLS's scripted morning, then the drill). **Prints** the line and chip second by second. **Holds** at most one line and one chip; none under 3 s unless an urgent one or its act ends it; no repeat within 60 s; T acts only while its rule fires; silence in a splash.
- **`moment-shower`**, **`moment-night`** (heavy; ROADMAP §2.3's node part, bots in `tests/bots/routine.mjs`). **Print** the timeline (real seconds by the splash model, game minutes, the interrupt, the body's bands before and after, the lateness) and save each beat into `.run/moments/`. **Hold** §6's checks 3 and 4. **`game-domains`** (updated): `body` in the order, `activity` to time.

### 5.3 stage

- **`view-splash`** (heavy, 16 px/m). The shower and test-night's night with its klaxon. **Prints** each phase's real seconds, the frame median and p95, draw calls, uploads. **Holds** the shower 4.29 s within 2 frames; p95 ≤ 18 ms at 60 Hz; nothing beyond the iris once inked. Shots of every vignette, the beat, looked at.
- **`view-squad`** (heavy). The klaxon's landing, 30 s watched. **Prints** each figure's frame per drawn frame. **Holds** no cell jump and no posture change without a transition frame; shots, looked at.
- **`figures-frames`** (quick): every new frame and the towel in four directions, in its cell, on the palette, none blank. **`figures-doll`**, **`kit-makers`**, **`render-bench`** (extended): each body mark, the vignette props in bounds, `splash-sleep`'s p95 ≤ 18 ms.

### 5.4 hud

- **`core-browser`** (heavy, extended). test-shower from the Tests menu: the goal; "shower · 10 min, done 19:4x" at a stall; the splash lands (the fast watch, "Water off.", the grime glyph emptying); Space snaps to the end; Backspace at minute 2 lands you in a towel with "finish your shower"; T at a sink drinks; C opens PERSONNEL; Esc in a splash opens the menu. test-night: R at the rack, the landing, the urgent line, T rises, R held shows the choices, the late card mid-drill; the end card, Score, Copy. **Prints** the texts, the phases' timeline, the rectangles at three window sizes, none overlapping.
- **`ui-splash`** (the controller on fed frames of 4, 16.7, 33 ms; the strip from an outcome), **`ui-instinct`** (tone, AZERTY keycaps, both chips, nothing urgent hidden), **`ui-scores`** (the line's exact form, the stored shape), **`ui-sheet`** (`wordsOf` for every band): quick. **`ui-audio`** (the klaxon's dB through 0, 1, 2 walls, the duck, the tick rate), **`audio-browser`** (the water in its part only, the flush, the klaxon, the bugle), **`bench-browser`** (`splash-sleep`'s row): extended.

## 7. Not in this release

Eating at the mess hall, its line and its meals (0.0.9); a canteen and every item (WEAPONS's kit, 0.0.6 on); money for the machines (CAREER). The squad's own needs, schedules, AI and walking (0.0.9): the squad only lies, rises, dresses and stands; the company-street muster with the first sergeant and the drill's other kinds (a recall, a fire drill, a lockdown); the duty NCO, the fire watch's rounds and the relief call (0.0.14). T's walking acts ("walk to the head") and the player's paths; E's look and glance wired (the frames exist). The Plan of the Day's blocks, formations, lateness to them, the instinct's `next` and `late` before blocks (0.0.14). Chapters, papers, the day splash, stances, resolvers, "call it a day". D and S sources (no danger, no visitor, no mail), the reflex card. Sweat and the two-node heat balance, Mars's weather and the night sky (0.0.12); air, radiation, G, suits, wounds, medicine, drugs, death. Fitness and effective fitness (0.0.13 to 0.0.15), the daily load cap, training injuries, microsleeps on watch. Skill checks (0.0.6): `bodyMods` exists with no roll to read it. The time-lapse of people walking through the iris (0.2). The sound gallery and scoring, captions. Settings ("short splashes", the instinct's quiet modes, the strip's all-nine). Moment fixtures and `tools/fixtures.mjs` (0.0.16).

## 8. Resolutions, and doc changes for the lead

Implementation matters by TECH §1.3, the rest by DESIGN.md and the user's rules; each (my call) unless a source is named.

1. **Numbering**: ROADMAP §4.1's 0.0.5 row ships as v0.0.4 (CONTRACTS §18).
2. **The drill is procedural** (the user, 2026-11-05): one a standby week, night `int(r, 7)` and minute `int(r, 241)` after 00:30 from `stream(seed, 'time:alert-drill', week)`; TIME §9.2's 22:00 to 05:00 cut to 00:30 to 04:30, so the slip lies inside the night and the squad sleeps. CAREER §5.2's pin to 02:30 on sol 0 is withdrawn; the test scene forces 02:30.
3. **The drill is an A interrupt** (ROADMAP §4.1; TIME §7.1's "base alert"), not CAREER §5.2's O wake event; reveille is the O event.
4. **Stand by your racks**: the drill musters at your rack's foot in utilities, due at 10 minutes, counted then, stood down at 30; nobody leaves the bay, so nobody pops. CAREER §5.2's company-street muster comes with walking people (0.0.9).
5. **How late is late**: TIME §9.5's classes from the due; no "early" class for an alarm; not mustered by the stand-down is missed.

## 9. The review's resolutions (the fixer, 2026-11-06)

The reviewers' findings on the built round, settled where they follow the docs and the user's tastes; each (my call) unless a source is named, and each pinned by a test that fails without it (`tests/time-review.test.mjs` unless named). Where this section and §2 to §8 disagree, this one is the later word.

27. **A resumed shower puts back what was worn into it**: `time.resume` keeps the outfit (`{ activity, spotId, remainingMs, untilMs, outfit }`), and a plan's part shortened by a resume or a fit keeps its full length and what was done of it (`fullMs`, `doneMs`, `fit` on `time.doing.parts`), so its effects go by the share lived of the whole part: the water counts once over both halves, a fitted shower lands cut short in a towel with a resume left, and an activity's fraction is of its length before the fit.
28. **Nothing starts while one of the player's transitions plays**: `startActivity` refuses `busy` and `handOffer` is null while `transPlaying(me, ms)`; `stepOnto` steps from the pose drawn (`poseAt`), not the end state; the move keys do not turn a rising player.
29. **A dress plays its frames before a transition still to come**: `poseAt` shows `dress` while standing with a pending transition (the stand-down's undressing); `time-placement` fails on any outfit change in sight outside a dress frame.
30. **The berth drawn is the pose's own**: `poseAt` and `figureOf` give the pose's `spotId` (a rise's berth until it leaves it; `trans.from.spotId`), and the view's `berthOf` reads it, falling back to the deck nearest the figure's height; `time-placement` fails on a berth frame off its berth.
31. **The count is at 5 minutes, and dressing in a drill is hurried**: `ALERT_DRILL.dueMs` 300,000 (02:35); dressing into utilities while a drill is open takes `DRESS_HURRY_K` 0.5 of TIME §8.2's (2.6 minutes from PT kit, a brief splash), the squad's too (§8 item 4 changed; TIME §8.2's emergency tempo, which it gives suit-up, extended to dressing).
32. **The count and the stand-down are O events** (prio 2, TIME §7.1's "a muster you are due at"; §8 item 3 kept for the klaxon): a skip begun in the drill lands at each for its beat (plaques THE COUNT, STAND DOWN). The count counts the player only standing mustered at its second; an arrival gone from the rack at the count or the stand-down is marked left (`leftMs`, the `late` fact's class `left`), and coming back before the stand-down arrives again, late.
33. **Stand fast**: a new activity, `standfast` (`class` rest, `mask` 'D A O B', its length to the open drill's stand-down), R's first offer at your rack's foot once mustered in utilities, and the drill line's T; `mustered()` holds through it. From the count to the stand-down every other activity is late ("the stand-down at your rack, 03:00", `fitMs` 0); before the count the timing rule holds for the mustered too.
34. **A night ended by its own reveille shows its strip**: an interrupt on the skip's planned end with no reflex runs the lapse to it, the beat, the strip, the zoom out (8.30 s for test-night's night).
35. **The morning routine is withdrawn this round**: a sink offers the basin and a drink; the urinal and the stall keep their own R (the routine bundled the head and the stall at a sink, the figure hidden in place).
36. **Sleep is never offered past reveille**, nor "until reveille" where the plan would not end on it; the head is offered only above `URINATE_MIN_ML` 50 mL.
37. **A woman's body grows no stubble** (`hasBeard`: a man's body, by the person's sex or the template's): no stubble stage past 0, no cue, no Shave row, no basin shave, no DI line.
38. **The scene's end card waits** `END_HOLD_S` 6 s of live play after the splash, or Enter ("Enter: end the scene"), C and J over the world meanwhile.
39. **The stall in a closed iris**: the shower stall and the floor to its spot cut down to `CUT_H_M` by the lift's uniforms at the iris's `inkK`, the see-through's dither let go; the bather in the stall through the dress part, stepping out over its last 15%, the steam clearing with them (`STEP_OUT_VK` 0.91); every vignette piece dissolving with `inkK`; a side-facing toilet stall's boots and slide on its south side.
40. **The career's first drill** falls on one of its first two nights (`drillOfWeek(seed, week, lon, firstNight)`: `firstNight + int(r, 2)` in the career's first week; later weeks unchanged): CAREER §5.2's first-night spike, still drawn.
41. **The instinct**: past the count the alarm's words say you missed it; no grooming lines from 21:50 to 05:00; woken in the night, back to sleep (T: `sleep:reveille` in the berth) or the head; tired before taps a note; no squad board by day; "T held" only on a chip with an act; T sent with no line seen does nothing (`instinctAction` with `id: null`); no humour in place of the drill's line.
42. **Smaller**: the bench card's frame times from rAF's timestamps; the slip in offers and the save line as '24:00 +N'; a sleep line's duration from the times it prints; the ticker's line gone after three gaps and at the strip; on landing only the cause and the activity's line as toasts; the test scenes' start body with its drawn traits and its first crossing posted; `time-parity` reads both bodies synced and holds the engines' own agreement.
